definitions.explanation: Not healthy or wholesome, either physically, mentally, or morally. Used for conditions, environments, relationships, finances, or content deemed harmful or improper.

examples.japanese: {不健全|ふけんぜん}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{青少年|せいしょうねん}→青少年：16559_seishounen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不健全|ふけんぜん}だ。
examples.english: This content is unwholesome for young people.

examples.japanese: {不健全|ふけんぜん}な⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{危|あや}うく→危うい：11825_ayaui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If an unsound financial condition continues for a long time, management will be at risk.

notes:
The negated form of ⟦{健全|けんぜん}→健全：11539_kenzen⟧ (healthy, sound), created by adding the prefix {不|ふ} (un-, non-). Functions as a な-adjective.

FORMS:
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}な + noun — attributive (unwholesome ~)
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}だ — predicative (is unwholesome)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ — unhealthy lifestyle
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}な⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧ — unwholesome environment
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ — unhealthy relationship
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}な⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧ — unsound finances
- {不健全|ふけんぜん}⟦{図書|としょ}→図書：03459_tosho⟧ — unwholesome publications (official term in content regulation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{健全|けんぜん}→健全：11539_kenzen⟧ — healthy; sound; wholesome (the positive form)
- ⟦{不衛生|ふえいせい}→不衛生：16776_fueisei⟧ — unsanitary; unhygienic (focuses on cleanliness)
- ⟦{有害|ゆうがい}→有害：13002_yuugai⟧ — harmful; noxious (stronger, implies actual damage)
